resources.string: Lokhu kwakhiwa kubonisa ukuphahlazeka esikhundleni sokukufihla. Kopisha noma wabelane ngombiko ngezansi, bese uwuthumela kunjiniyela. Umbiko uthi yini ehlulekile, kuliphi icala nokuthi iyiphi idivayisi. Awuqukethe lutho oluthayiphile.
Uhlelo lokusebenza alukwazi ukufinyelela ebhodini lokunamathisela.
Le divayisi ayinayo i-app ye-imeyili. Sebenzisa i-Copy noma i-Share esikhundleni salokho.
Ayikho uhlelo lokusebenza kule divayisi olungabelana ngombiko. Sebenzisa Kopisha esikhundleni salokho.
Le divayisi ayikwazi ukuvula isikhethi sekhibhodi. Shintsha ikhibhodi kuzilungiselelo zesistimu.
I-Android ayisayibonisi lesi sicelo, ngoba wenqabe imvume ngaphambilini. Usengakwazi ukuyivula kusuka esikrinini sezilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza.
Akukho ukuxhumana. Hlola inethiwekhi yakho bese uzama futhi.
Isicelo sithathe isikhathi eside kakhulu. Zama futhi.
Kuphela uma isipele esizenzakalelayo sehluleka. Izipele eziphumelelayo zithule.
Ikhompyutha ebhangqwe nge-KDE Connect icele ukubhangqa, yathumela ifayela, noma yashaya uphondo ngenkathi ikhibhodi ifihliwe.
Inqubekelaphambili yezichazamazwi, amamodeli ezwi, izengezo namanye amafayela ikhibhodi ewalandayo, kanye nomugqa lapho okuthile kuqeda noma kwehluleka.
Okufakiwe okuphakade emthunzini wokubonisa ikhibhodi nokuyikhipha. Kuphela ngenkathi uyivula.
Inguqulo entsha ongayifaka, isibuyekezo esilinde ukuthi ucindezele ukufaka, kanye nesiqinisekiso uma esisodwa sesifakiwe.

Ikhibhodi ye-WM ifunda imicimbi yakho. Ithuluzi lekhalenda liyayibala, futhi ungayifaka njengombhalo. Ikhibhodi ifunda ikhalenda lakho kuphela ngenkathi lelo thuluzi livuliwe. Ikhibhodi ayilokothi ibhale ekhalendeni lakho. Imicimbi yakho ihlala kudivayisi yakho. Ithuluzi aliphoqelekile.

Ikhibhodi ye-WM ivula ikhamera kuphela ngenkathi ithuluzi lekhamera lisikrinini. Ungathatha isithombe usifake kuhlelo lokusebenza obhala kulo. Ikhibhodi ibhala isithombe kwisitoreji sayo esiyimfihlo. Ikhibhodi inikeza isithombe kulolo hlelo lokusebenza uma usifaka. Ikhibhodi ayilayishi sithombe, futhi ayithumeli sithombe kunjiniyela. Ithuluzi lingakhethwa.

Ikhibhodi ye-WM ifunda amakheli e-imeyili koxhumana nabo. Uma uthayipha ukuqala kwekheli, ikhibhodi inikeza ikheli eligcwele. Ikhibhodi igcina amakheli enkumbulweni ngenkathi isebenza, futhi ayiwabhaleli kufayela. Amakheli awashiyi idivayisi yakho. Isilungiselelo singokuzithandela. Sihlala sicishiwe uze usivule.

Ikhibhodi ye-WM ifunda amagama koxhumana nabo. Amagama bese epheleliswa njengoba uthayipha, futhi ukulungisa okuzenzakalelayo akushintshi. Ikhibhodi igcina amagama enkumbulweni ngenkathi isebenza, futhi ayiwabhali kunoma yiliphi ifayela. Amagama awasoze aphuma kudivayisi yakho. Lesi silungiselelo singokuzikhethela. Sihlala sivaliwe kuze kube yilapho usivula.
Ukufinyelela koxhumana nabo ukuze uthole iziphakamiso zamagama

Ikhibhodi ye-WM ibheka izithombe-skrini ezintsha futhi izibeke kubhodi yokunamathisela. Ungafaka eyodwa ngaphandle kokushiya uhlelo lokusebenza okulo. I-Android ayinayo imvume yezithombe-skrini kuphela, ngakho inikeza ukufinyelela kuzo zonke izithombe zakho. Ikhibhodi ibheka kuphela izithombe-skrini ezintsha. Izithombe zihlala kudivayisi yakho. Ikhibhodi ifaka isithombe kuphela uma usicindezela. Lesi silungiselelo singokuzikhethela. Sihlala sivaliwe kuze kube yilapho usivula.

Ikhibhodi ye-WM irekhoda umsindo kuphela ngemva kokuba ucindezele inkinobho yemakrofoni, futhi kuphela ngenkathi ukhuluma. Ukuqoshwa kuya kusevisi yokubona inkulumo ekhethwe kuzilungiselelo zakho ze-Android. Leyo sevisi iguqula ukuqoshwa kube umbhalo. Kumafoni amaningi leyo sevisi ngeka-Google, futhi u-Google angacubungula umsindo kumaseva ayo. Imodeli engaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi igcina umsindo kudivayisi yakho. Ikhibhodi ayiwugcini umsindo. Isevisi yokubona inkulumo kuphela eyitholayo. Ukuthayipha ngezwi kuyakhetheka. Konke okunye okukhibhodi kusebenza ngaphandle kwakho.

Ikhibhodi isebenzisa izaziso ukukwazisa ngezinto eziqeda ngenkathi ukwenye indawo: isichazamazwi noma imodeli yezwi elandiwe, isibuyekezo esilinde ukufakwa, isipele esizenzakalelayo esihlulekile. Ayithumeli okunye — azikho izeluleko, azikho iziphakamiso, akukho ukukhangisa — futhi zonke izinhlobo zingacishwa ngokwehlukana kokuthi Izilungiselelo › Izaziso. Ukwenqaba akushintshi lutho mayelana nendlela ikhibhodi ethayipha ngayo.

Ku-Android 9 nangaphambili, ikhibhodi idinga imvume yokugcina ukuze ilondoloze isithombe kugalari yakho. Imvume yakudala ye-Android iphinde ihlanganise ukufunda isitoreji sakho. Ikhibhodi ibhala kuphela isithombe ocela ukuba ilondoloze. Ikhibhodi ayifundi lutho futhi ayilayishi lutho. Izinguqulo ezintsha ze-Android azidingi le mvume.
Ukufinyelela kwisitoreji ukuze ulondoloze kugalari yakho

Le nsizakalo yenza ukuthi ukunyakaza kwekhibhodi kutholakale ngenkathi isifundi sesikrini sisebenza. Lokhu kunyakaza kuyisinciphisi sebha yesikhala, ukuswayipha kwegama le-backspace, ukuthayipha okushelelayo nokubhala ngesandla. Inkonzo yokufinyeleleka kuphela engakwenza lokhu. Insizakalo ayibhaliseli imicimbi yokufinyeleleka. Ayikwazi ukufunda okuqukethwe kwewindi. Ayimaki lutho ngaphandle kwegridi yokhiye yekhibhodi uqobo. Ayiqoqi datha. Isikrini sokufinyeleleka se-Android sixwayisa ngamandla aphelele alesi sigaba. Le nsizakalo ayimemezeli lutho lwalolo mandla.

Ukuze ufake inguqulo entsha, i-Android kumele ivumele lolu hlelo lokusebenza ukufaka izinhlelo zokusebenza. Uhlelo lokusebenza lusebenzisa leyo mvume entweni eyodwa: inguqulo entsha yalo oyilande ekhasini lokukhishwa kwephrojekthi futhi wacindezela okuthi Faka. Ngaphambi kokuba ibuze, uhlelo lokusebenza luqhathanisa ifayela ne-checksum ekukhishweni kanye nokhiye leli faka elisayinwe ngawo. I-Android ibonisa ukuqinisekiswa kwayo kokubuyekeza kokuqala. Uhlelo lokusebenza alusoze lwafaka olunye uhlelo lokusebenza, futhi alusoze lwafaka noma yini ongazange ucindezele okuthi Faka kuyo.

Uma ikhodi yokuqinisekisa ifika kwisaziso, ikhibhodi ingayiphakamisa njenge-chip ngaphezu kwezinkinobho, ukuthepha okukodwa ukusuka lapho uthayiphe khona. Ukuze ubone ikhodi ifika, ikhibhodi idinga ukufinyelela kwizaziso. Ngenkathi lesi sici sivuliwe, ikhibhodi ifunda umbhalo wezaziso ezingenayo kudivayisi yakho ukuze ithole ikhodi. Ikhodi igcinwa kuphela kwimemori, imizuzu embalwa kuphela, futhi ayithunyelwa ndawo. Ukufinyelela okufanayo kuphinde kunikeze amandla ithuluzi lemidiya elikhethwayo, elingafundi okuqukethwe kwesaziso. Isikrini sesistimu osivulayo sichaza ukufinyelela okugcwele okunganikezwa yile mvume. Lolu hlelo lokusebenza luyisebenzisela lezi zici ezimbili kuphela. Vala lesi sici bese ikhibhodi iyeka ukufunda izaziso ngaso leso sikhathi.

I-Android inikeza izilawuli zokudlala, ukumisa isikhashana nokweqa kuphela ezinhlelweni zokusebenza ezifinyelela kuzaziso. Ithuluzi lemidiya lidinga lokho kufinyelela. Kuleli thuluzi, isilaleli sezaziso sekhibhodi asifundi saziso, asifundi isihloko, asifundi umthumeli futhi asifundi okuqukethwe. Sikhona kuphela ukuze i-Android ivumele ithuluzi ukuthi libone iseshini yemidiya yamanje. Ukufinyelela okufanayo kuphinde kunikeze amandla isicucu sekhodi yesikhathi esisodwa esikuzilungiselelo zokuthayipha. Kuphela uma lokho kuvuliwe lapho isilaleli sifunda umbhalo wesaziso, kudivayisi yakho, ukuze sithole ikhodi yokuqinisekisa. Ikhibhodi ayigcini lutho, futhi akukho okushiya idivayisi yakho. Isikrini sesistimu osuzovula sichaza ukufinyelela okugcwele okunganikezwa yile mvume. Lolu hlelo lokusebenza luyisebenzisela lezi zici ezimbili kuphela futhi akukho okunye. Zombili ziyakhetheka.

Ngokufinyelela kokusetshenziswa, ikhibhodi irekhoda ukuthi yiluphi uhlelo lokusebenza olwalungaphambili lapho ukopisha okuthile. Ibonisa lolo hlelo lokusebenza uma ucindezela ubambe isiqeshana. Ikhibhodi ifunda uhlelo lokusebenza olungaphambili kuphela ngesikhathi sokukopisha. Ayifundi umlando wakho noma isikhathi sakho kuhlelo lokusebenza. Ikhibhodi igcina impendulo nesiqeshana, kudivayisi yakho kuphela. Akukho okumayelana nokusetshenziswa kohlelo lwakho lokusebenza okuphuma kudivayisi yakho. Lesi silungiselelo singokuzikhethela. Sihlala sivaliwe uze usivule.
Ukufinyelela kokusetshenziswa kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zomthombo webhodi lokunamathisela
